start_args.description: List of command-line arguments to pass to cmst (e.g., ['-m', '-d']). Each entry becomes a separate override line.

wait_time.description: Seconds to wait before attempting to create the tray icon (for use with auto-start, when tray may not yet be ready).

icon_scale.description: Icon scaling factor: 1.0 to 3.0. Use 2.0 for high-DPI displays.

fake_transparency.description: Hex RRGGBB color to simulate tray icon transparency when the system tray does not support true transparency.

counter_update_kb.description: [Experimental] Data threshold in KB to trigger a counter update.

icon_theme.description: Icon theme name. CMST will try to use icons from that theme. If not provided, it falls back to the system-wide theme or internal icons.
